UnexpectedEvents.Name: Financial Crisis
UnexpectedEvents.Description: Banks tightened credit, the stock market crashed and lending rates spiked. Economic output and the budget deficit are seriously affected.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Terror Attack
UnexpectedEvents.Description: A terror attack caused heavy civilian and material casualties. Security concerns and militarization are rising.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Cyber Attack
UnexpectedEvents.Description: Critical infrastructure and state systems were hit by a cyber attack. Energy and financial systems are affected.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Energy Crisis
UnexpectedEvents.Description: Energy supply shortages are pressuring industry and heating. Prices and inflation are rising.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Industrial Accident
UnexpectedEvents.Description: A serious accident at an industrial facility. Environment and health indicators are negatively affected.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Assassination Attempt
UnexpectedEvents.Description: An assassination attempt was made on a high-ranking official. Political instability and military visibility are rising.

UnexpectedEvents.Name: Leak Scandal
UnexpectedEvents.Description: The leak of official documents is damaging the government's reputation. Corruption perception and media polarization are rising.
